title: Tarangire, Serengeti & Ngorongoro Crater
summary: Tarangire's baobab trees, the Serengeti plains and a morning in the Ngorongoro Crater.
overviewParagraphs: Africa's famous baobab trees combined with Tanzania's best-known parks. Day 1 is in Tarangire, days 2 and 3 in the Serengeti, and day 4 in the Ngorongoro Crater.
You can join a group to keep the cost down, or book a private tour. The itinerary can be changed: add a park, an extra night or a few days on Zanzibar.
highlights: Baobab trees and elephant herds in Tarangire
Game drives across the Serengeti plains
Picnic lunch at the hippo pool on the crater floor
A chance to see the Big Five
Hotel pick-up and drop-off in Arusha

practicalInformation: Bring a valid passport, arrange the appropriate Tanzania visa and travel with comprehensive travel insurance.
Park roads can be dusty and uneven. Soft-sided luggage is easier to store in the safari vehicle.
Please tell us about allergies, dietary requirements, mobility needs and celebrations before arrival.
Drinking water is supplied on safari. Keep cash for tips and small personal purchases.
packingNotes: Light neutral clothing, a warm layer for early mornings and the Ngorongoro highlands, and a light rain jacket.
Closed walking shoes, sun hat, sunglasses, sunscreen, insect repellent and personal medication.
Binoculars, camera, spare batteries and a soft-sided bag suitable for the safari vehicle.
Tanzania uses UK-style Type G plugs. Keep valuables, documents and essential medication in your day bag.
bookingConditions: This itinerary is a proposal. Accommodation, room category and final routing remain subject to availability until confirmed in writing.
Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed. Driving times and distances are estimates and may change with road, weather and park conditions.
Your final quotation will state the deposit, payment schedule, cancellation terms and any seasonal supplements.
Travellers are responsible for passports, visas, travel insurance, vaccinations and medical advice applicable to their journey.

faqs.question: How much does a safari cost?
faqs.answer: From $200 per person per day (camping, joining a group) to $550 per person per day (private safari, lodge accommodation). Park fees, accommodation, meals, transport and drinking water are included.

faqs.question: What's included?
faqs.answer: Accommodation, meals on safari, transport, drinking water and park activities listed in your proposal are included.

faqs.question: Can I change the itinerary?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every trip can be changed until it fits your dates, interests and preferred comfort level.

faqs.question: Private tour or join a group?
faqs.answer: Both are possible. Tell us your preference and we will explain the options for your dates.

faqs.question: When is the best time to go?
faqs.answer: Tanzania is a year-round destination. The best time depends on the parks, wildlife and activities you want to experience.

faqs.question: Can you arrange airport transfers and a hotel in Arusha?
faqs.answer: Yes. Airport transfers and an Arusha hotel before or after your trip can be added on request.

faqs.question: I have dietary requirements. Is that OK?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tell us about dietary requirements when you request your quote so the team can plan ahead.

faqs.question: How do I book?
faqs.answer: Send your dates and group details. We will prepare an itinerary and price, then explain the next steps.
